content_blocks.text: Overview
heading_path: Publication of contract opportunities on Contracts Finder
Overview

content_blocks.text: This regulation provides that a contracting authority, when advertising a below-threshold contract award opportunity (i.e. by putting the opportunity in the public domain or bringing it to the attention of suppliers generally or a broad, potentially open-ended subset of suppliers), it must also publish information about the opportunity on Contracts Finder within 24 hours of advertisement.
heading_path: Publication of contract opportunities on Contracts Finder
Overview

content_blocks.text: Regulation 110 also states that contracting authorities may publish relevant information on Contracts Finder, even where the contract award opportunity has not been advertised in any other way.
heading_path: Publication of contract opportunities on Contracts Finder
Overview

content_blocks.text: The relevant information for publication under Regulation 110 must at least cover:
heading_path: Publication of contract opportunities on Contracts Finder
Overview

content_blocks.text: the timeframe for suppliers to respond to the opportunity (which should allow suppliers a sufficient, but not disproportionate, period of time to respond)
heading_path: Publication of contract opportunities on Contracts Finder
Overview

content_blocks.text: how and to whom suppliers should respond, and
heading_path: Publication of contract opportunities on Contracts Finder
Overview

content_blocks.text: any other requirements for participating in the procurement.
heading_path: Publication of contract opportunities on Contracts Finder
Overview

content_blocks.text: Regulation 110 also states that contracting authorities should ensure that relevant contract documents (as defined by this regulation) are made available to interested suppliers.
heading_path: Publication of contract opportunities on Contracts Finder
Overview

content_blocks.text: Objective at this commercial stage
heading_path: Publication of contract opportunities on Contracts Finder
Objective at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: If the below-threshold procurement opportunity is advertised to suppliers, then the information set out in this regulation (i.e. regulation 110) must also be published on Contracts Finder. Where the procurement is not advertised to suppliers, the contracting authority may nevertheless choose to publish the information on Contracts Finder voluntarily.
heading_path: Publication of contract opportunities on Contracts Finder

content_blocks.text: Contracting authorities should:
heading_path: Publication of contract opportunities on Contracts Finder
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: consider the information that should be published on Contracts Finder
heading_path: Publication of contract opportunities on Contracts Finder
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: ensure that the information published on Contracts Finder includes the information required under this regulation (i.e. regulation 110)
heading_path: Publication of contract opportunities on Contracts Finder
Key considerations at this commercial stage

content_blocks.text: ensure that any relevant contract documents (as defined by this regulation) are shared with suppliers, unless there is a relevant reason for not doing so.
